meta.title: Offer & Contact — Chalet Yolo, Méribel
meta.description: Winter 2026–2027 rates and stay enquiry for Chalet Yolo, a fully catered private chalet in Méribel: dates, what is included and number of guests.

offer.title: Winter 2026–2027
offer.label: Winter 2026–2027 rates, fully catered
offer.note: Public prices in euros, VAT included, for the dates shown. Weekly stays run Saturday to Saturday.

included.title: Included
items: The whole chalet, yours alone: 330 m², six bedrooms, up to 15 guests
Indoor pool, jacuzzi, hammam, sauna, yoga and fitness room, home cinema
Private chef every day: breakfast, après-ski tea, apéritif and dinner*
Private van to and from the slopes
Bed linen and towels, changed mid-stay
Wi-Fi, ski room with boot dryers, secure indoor parking

extras.title: Not included
items: On request: ski passes, ski hire, ski lessons, station and airport transfers, in-chalet massages, driver for other trips
** Closing week: self-catered, chalet rental only
